title: Couscous salad with chicken, orange and mint
steps: Pour 150 ml hot salted water over the couscous, leave covered for 5 minutes and fluff up.
Season the chicken with cumin and salt, fry it in 1 tsp oil for 5–6 minutes per side and dice it.
Peel and segment the orange, finely dice the cucumber and onion and chop the herbs.
Mix everything with lemon juice and the remaining oil and sprinkle with chopped almonds.
